definitions.explanation: Containing poison or producing harmful effects on living organisms. Used in chemistry, biology, medicine, environmental science, and food-safety contexts to describe substances, gases, plants, and animals that can injure or kill. A neutral scientific/formal term — not metaphorical ('toxic' relationship, 'toxic' behavior). Functions as both a na-adjective and a no-adjective; also very common as a prefix in compound nouns: {有毒|ゆうどく}ガス ('toxic gas').

examples.japanese: {有毒|ゆうどく}な⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内臓|ないぞう}→内臓：05028_naizou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有毒|ゆうどく}な⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: The internal organs of this fish contain toxic substances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{漏|も}れた→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧{有毒|ゆうどく}⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}した→避難する：26827_hinansuru⟧。
examples.english: Residents in the area evacuated due to toxic gas that leaked from the factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野生|やせい}→野生：14439_yasei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧キノコ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食用|しょくよう}→食用：25328_shokuyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{有毒|ゆうどく}なもの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{素人|しろうと}→素人：04270_shirouto⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: Some wild mushrooms are edible and others are poisonous, so amateur judgment is dangerous.

notes:
Compound of {有|ゆう} ('having; possessing') and ⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧ ('poison'), literally 'having poison'. Pattern {有|ゆう}- vs ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧- ('not having') produces matched antonyms: {有毒|ゆうどく} / ⟦{無毒|むどく}→無毒：27157_mudoku⟧, ⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧ / ⟦{無害|むがい}→無害：25474_mugai⟧, ⟦{有料|ゆうりょう}→有料：03178_yuuryou⟧ / ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧.

USAGE:
- As a na-adjective before nouns: {有毒|ゆうどく}な⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧ ('poisonous plant'), {有毒|ゆうどく}な⟦{物質|ぶっしつ}→物質：03608_busshitsu⟧ ('toxic substance').
- As a prefix in compound nouns without な: {有毒|ゆうどく}⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧, {有毒|ゆうどく}⟦{物質|ぶっしつ}→物質：03608_busshitsu⟧, {有毒|ゆうどく}⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧.
- Used literally, not metaphorically. For emotionally/socially harmful situations Japanese usually prefers ⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧ ('harmful') or borrows トキシック.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有毒|ゆうどく}⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧: toxic gas
- {有毒|ゆうどく}⟦{物質|ぶっしつ}→物質：03608_busshitsu⟧: toxic substance
- {有毒|ゆうどく}⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧: toxic component
- {有毒|ゆうどく}⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧: poisonous plant
- {有毒|ゆうどく}⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧: venomous/poisonous creature
- {有毒|ゆうどく}⟦{廃棄|はいき}{物|ぶつ}→廃棄物：04634_haikibutsu⟧: toxic waste
- {有毒|ゆうどく}⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧: toxic smoke/fumes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧: harmful — broader; covers anything damaging to health or society (pollution, bad influence), not only poisons.
- ⟦{毒性|どくせい}→毒性：22201_dokusei⟧: toxicity — the noun describing the property; ⟦{毒性|どくせい}→毒性：22201_dokusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ ('highly toxic').
- ⟦{猛毒|もうどく}→猛毒：19081_moudoku⟧: deadly poison — an intensified noun; a step up from {有毒|ゆうどく}.
- ⟦{無毒|むどく}→無毒：27157_mudoku⟧: non-toxic; harmless
